nodes.label: multitask.yaml Training Config
nodes.rationale: grade_weight 0.6, factor_weight 0.4/3 split across three factor heads; batch 4.

nodes.label: mvp_8gb.yaml Training Config
nodes.rationale: Same as mvp.yaml but batch 4 / 2 workers to fit dual 600x840 inputs + ConvNeXt on ~8GB GPUs.

nodes.label: PSA Daily Quota / Retry-After Exhaustion
nodes.rationale: Tokens 1-5 hit upstream quota (~86k s Retry-After) quickly; token 0 hit local 1000-call cap since Pokemon hits cost ~2 calls (details + images).

nodes.label: upsert_cert (idempotent cert storage)
nodes.rationale: DB is source of truth; re-scanning a seen cert is safe but wastes API quota.

nodes.label: Condition CV (corners/edges/surface)
nodes.rationale: Classical heuristics need no extra labels and ship interpretable scores; can be swapped for learned heads without API change.

nodes.label: eBay Browse API (bulk training source)
nodes.rationale: User photos give generalization but are noisier; used for bulk training.

nodes.label: Multi-task Factor Heads (pseudo-labelled)
nodes.rationale: Classical-CV pseudo-labels supervise auxiliary heads to improve the shared backbone; API still serves CV sub-grades.

nodes.label: Precrop Step (ml.data.precrop)
nodes.rationale: One-time dewarp to data/crops/ speeds training; configs use use_precrop: true and skip live detect_and_crop.

nodes.label: PSA Public API (high-fidelity validation)
nodes.rationale: Official images and verified grades but low daily quota; preferred for val/test, not bulk.

nodes.label: collect_all Multi-Token PSA Harvest
nodes.rationale: Six bearer tokens (PSA_API_TOKEN0-5) run in series, each scanning its own 5k-wide cert window to multiply daily PSA quota.

nodes.label: Non-Overlapping 5k Cert Windows
nodes.rationale: Starts spaced by 5,000 when --count 5000 so tokens never rescan the same certs and waste quota.

nodes.label: Cert Window Resume Strategy
nodes.rationale: Use logged 'local quota exhausted before reaching N' as next --start-cert; do not advance to next 5k block until current finishes. No dedicated resume subcommand exists.

nodes.label: CORN Ordinal Regression
nodes.rationale: PSA grades are ordered and imbalanced (9/10 dominate); ordinal loss plus stratified sampling handles this.

nodes.label: No Condition-Altering Augmentation
nodes.rationale: Scratches, heavy rotation, edge crops would change the apparent grade label.

nodes.label: smoke.yaml Training Config
nodes.rationale: Few-minute run on ~100 cards to verify train->checkpoint->export->serve loop; num_workers 0 for Windows stability.
